scope: post hoc corrected gate; diagnostic only, not a pass
why: G2 as predeclared measured the single-bank baseline draw. Replication one drew 46 and passed, replication two drew 92 and failed, while single-bank parents span 46 to 104.
correction: score the small-history parent as its expected value over every contiguous window of that size, paired by transfer bank
limits: Post hoc. A gate redesigned after seeing results cannot produce a pass; these numbers say what to predeclare on fresh banks.
Contiguous windows over one development panel are not independent samples, so the expected-small estimate has unmodelled dependence.
The large-history arm is still a single parent, so its own draw is not averaged over.
Best constant uses final labels and is not deployable.
